# P10 · Teacher flows on both channels: lessons, taps, result: tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** after the check, a teacher's track runs as flows on Telegram and in the web app: T4 lessons with the badge line and two taps, T6 her result, within the time cap. Reduced scope (see DECISIONS 2026-10-27): call 9, voice reflections and the biweekly prompts are cut.

**Starting commit:** `0e2ea8f` · **Started:** 2026-10-27

- [x] **T01 · Lesson view, schedule, time budget** (`services/content/lessons_view.py`, `services/api/time_budget.py`; `tests/flows/test_t4.py`: schedule two a week, weekly minutes, 5-minute gate)
- [x] **T02 · T4 flow and the two taps** (`services/api/flows/t4.py`, table `lesson_taps`; tests: lesson one at once with voice note, badge, simulated label; taps stored; "later"; last lesson and model lesson; erasure removes taps)
- [x] **T03 · T6 my result** (counts only, no percentage, no comparison; real teacher only after two checks)
- [x] **T04 · Both channels** (Telegram `sendVoice` from a signed lesson link, web audio player; `tests/channels/test_t4_golden.py`: same words and choices in both channels, same stored taps, voice-note request shape, link serves only listed audio and expires)
- [x] **T05 · Judge seed** (`scripts/seed_demo_track.py`, `tests/content/test_seed_demo.py`: refuses outside judge mode, never approves a held draft)
- [x] **T06 · Docs** (`docs/channels.md` T4/T6 diagram, DECISIONS, PARKING)
- [ ] **Cut:** call 9, voice reflections, biweekly prompts, offline replay of lessons in the web app, CPD export, mentor name in T4.
